name: bandwidthd
comment: Tracks bandwidth usage by IP address
desc:
bandwidthd tracks usage of TCP/IP network subnets and logs per-IP traffic as a
CDF time series (and optionally renders HTML graphs). It color codes HTTP, TCP,
UDP, ICMP, VPN and P2P traffic. Unlike MRTG it tracks each individual IP address
rather than the status of a link.

Repackaged from the unmaintained FreeBSD net-mgmt/bandwidthd port for OPNsense,
whose package repository does not carry it.
